productions.title: P vs NP
productions.claim: Asks whether every problem whose answer can be checked in polynomial time can also be solved in polynomial time. A proof either way reshapes cryptography, optimization and AI search.

productions.title: Riemann hypothesis
productions.claim: Claims every nontrivial zero of the Riemann zeta function lies on the line with real part one half. It controls the error term in the distribution of primes.

productions.title: Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness
productions.claim: Asks whether smooth initial data for the 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations always gives a smooth solution for all time, or whether blow-up can occur.

productions.title: Yang-Mills mass gap
productions.claim: Asks for a rigorous construction of 4D quantum Yang-Mills theory with a positive lower bound on the mass of its excitations.

productions.title: Hodge conjecture
productions.claim: Claims that on a projective complex manifold, certain cohomology classes are rational combinations of classes of algebraic subvarieties.

productions.title: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture
productions.claim: Links the rank of an elliptic curve's group of rational points to the order of vanishing of its L-function at s = 1.

productions.title: Poincare conjecture
productions.claim: Every simply connected closed 3-manifold is the 3-sphere. Perelman proved it in 2003 with Ricci flow with surgery.

productions.title: Fermat's Last Theorem
productions.claim: No positive integers satisfy a^n + b^n = c^n for n above 2. Wiles proved it in 1994 through modularity of semistable elliptic curves.

formal_source.label: Buzzard, FLT formalization project in Lean

productions.title: Four color theorem
productions.claim: Four colors suffice for any planar map. Proved by computer in 1976 and checked in Coq by Gonthier in 2005.

formal_source.label: Gonthier, Formal proof of the four color theorem in Coq, Notices AMS 2008

productions.title: Kepler conjecture
productions.claim: Face-centered cubic packing is the densest packing of equal spheres. Hales proved it in 1998, and the Flyspeck project checked the proof formally in 2014.

formal_source.label: Hales et al., A formal proof of the Kepler conjecture, Forum of Mathematics Pi 2017

productions.title: Twin prime conjecture
productions.claim: Claims infinitely many primes p have p + 2 also prime. Zhang, Maynard and Polymath bounded the gap at 246.

productions.title: Goldbach conjecture
productions.claim: Claims every even integer above 2 is a sum of two primes. Verified to 4 x 10^18, and the weak ternary version was proved by Helfgott in 2013.

productions.title: Collatz conjecture
productions.claim: Claims that iterating n to n/2 or 3n+1 reaches 1 from every start. Tao showed almost all orbits attain almost bounded values.

productions.title: abc conjecture
productions.claim: Bounds c by the radical of abc for coprime a + b = c. Mochizuki's claimed proof is not accepted by most number theorists.

productions.title: Langlands program
productions.claim: A web of conjectures matching Galois representations with automorphic forms, a grand unified theory for number theory.

productions.title: Geometric Langlands conjecture
productions.claim: The geometric form of Langlands, proved in 2024 by Gaitsgory, Raskin and collaborators across a series of papers near 1000 pages long.

productions.title: Sensitivity conjecture
productions.claim: Boolean sensitivity is polynomially related to block sensitivity. Huang proved it in 2019 with a two page argument on the hypercube.

productions.title: Cap set problem
productions.claim: Bounds the largest subset of F_3^n with no three-term progression. Ellenberg and Gijswijt proved an exponential bound in 2016 with the polynomial method.

formal_source.label: Dahmen, Holzl, Lewis, Formalizing the solution to the cap set problem, ITP 2019

productions.title: Polynomial Freiman-Ruzsa conjecture
productions.claim: Sets with small doubling in F_2^n are covered by few cosets of a subgroup. Gowers, Green, Manners and Tao proved it in 2023, formalized in Lean within three weeks.

formal_source.label: Tao et al., PFR project in Lean

productions.title: Diagonal Ramsey exponential improvement
productions.claim: Campos, Griffiths, Morris and Sahasrabudhe improved the 1935 upper bound of 4^k on diagonal Ramsey numbers by an exponential factor in 2023.

productions.title: Hadwiger-Nelson problem
productions.claim: Asks for the fewest colors so no two points at unit distance share one. The answer lies between 5 and 7 after de Grey's 2018 graph.

productions.title: Busy Beaver BB(5)
productions.claim: BB(5) = 47,176,870, settled in 2024 by the bbchallenge collaboration with a Coq proof.

productions.title: Graph isomorphism complexity
productions.claim: Asks whether graph isomorphism is in P. Babai gave a quasipolynomial algorithm in 2015.

productions.title: Matrix multiplication exponent omega
productions.claim: Asks for the exponent omega of matrix multiplication. The bound sits near 2.371 and could be 2.

productions.title: Unique Games Conjecture
productions.claim: Khot's conjecture that approximating unique games is NP-hard. It would pin the exact approximation thresholds of many problems.

productions.title: BQP vs BPP separation
productions.claim: Asks whether quantum computers solve problems classical randomized machines cannot, in the unrelativized world.

productions.title: Integer factoring complexity
productions.claim: Asks for the classical complexity of factoring integers. RSA rests on its hardness, and Shor's algorithm breaks it on a quantum machine.

productions.title: Existence of one-way functions
productions.claim: Asks whether functions exist that are easy to compute and hard to invert on average. All private-key cryptography depends on them.

productions.title: Halting problem
productions.claim: No algorithm decides whether an arbitrary program halts. Turing proved it by diagonalization in 1936.

productions.title: Hilbert's tenth problem
productions.claim: No algorithm decides whether a Diophantine equation has integer solutions. Matiyasevich completed the proof in 1970.

formal_source.label: Bayer et al., A formal proof of the MRDP theorem in Isabelle, 2019

productions.title: Continuum hypothesis independence
productions.claim: The continuum hypothesis is independent of ZFC. Godel showed consistency in 1940 and Cohen showed independence by forcing in 1963.

formal_source.label: Han, van Doorn, Flypitch: independence of the continuum hypothesis in Lean, 2019

productions.title: Invariant subspace problem
productions.claim: Asks whether every bounded operator on a separable Hilbert space has a nontrivial closed invariant subspace.

productions.title: Jacobian conjecture
productions.claim: Claims a polynomial map with constant nonzero Jacobian determinant has a polynomial inverse.

productions.title: Hadamard matrix conjecture
productions.claim: Claims a Hadamard matrix exists for every order divisible by 4. Order 668 is the smallest open case.

productions.title: Protein structure prediction
productions.claim: Predict 3D protein structure from sequence. AlphaFold 2 reached experimental accuracy in CASP14 in 2020.

productions.title: Protein folding pathway kinetics
productions.claim: Explain how and how fast a chain finds its native fold, the kinetic side left open by structure prediction.

productions.title: Turbulence closure
productions.claim: Close the Reynolds-averaged equations from first principles, and derive Kolmogorov scaling and its intermittency corrections.

productions.title: Quantum gravity
productions.claim: Find a consistent quantum theory of gravity that reduces to general relativity at low energy.

productions.title: Dark matter identity
productions.claim: Identify the matter that shapes rotation curves, lensing and the CMB but emits no light.

productions.title: Cosmological constant problem
productions.claim: Explain why the measured vacuum energy sits about 120 orders of magnitude below the field theory estimate.

productions.title: Hubble tension
productions.claim: The local distance ladder gives H0 near 73 km/s/Mpc while the CMB gives near 67. Systematics or new physics.

productions.title: Weak cosmic censorship
productions.claim: Claims generic gravitational collapse hides every singularity behind an event horizon.

productions.title: Black hole information paradox
productions.claim: Asks whether black hole evaporation destroys information. Island calculations reproduce a unitary Page curve.

productions.title: Quantum measurement problem
productions.claim: Asks how definite outcomes and the Born rule arise from unitary quantum evolution.

productions.title: Room-temperature superconductivity mechanism
productions.claim: Explain the pairing mechanism of high-temperature superconductors well enough to design one that works at room temperature.

productions.title: 2D Hubbard model ground state
productions.claim: Find the ground state phase diagram of the 2D Hubbard model, the minimal model for cuprates.

productions.title: Fermion sign problem
productions.claim: Quantum Monte Carlo for fermions suffers exponential cancellation. Troyer and Wiese showed a general fix is NP-hard.

productions.title: Glass transition
productions.claim: Explain why liquids cooled past freezing stiffen into amorphous solids without a clear thermodynamic transition.

productions.title: Anomalous properties of water
productions.claim: Explain water's density maximum, heat capacity and interface structure from its hydrogen bond network.

productions.title: Rational catalyst design
productions.claim: Predict the best catalyst for a reaction from first principles, past the limits of linear scaling relations.

productions.title: Exact exchange-correlation functional
productions.claim: Find the exact exchange-correlation functional that makes Kohn-Sham DFT exact. It exists by the Hohenberg-Kohn theorem.

productions.title: Origin of life
productions.claim: Derive a chemical path from prebiotic molecules to self-replicating, evolving cells.

productions.title: Mitochondrial redox and aging mechanism
productions.claim: Explain how electron transport, redox state and membrane potential in mitochondria set the rate of aging.

productions.title: Light, circadian biology and metabolism
productions.claim: Quantify how light timing and spectrum drive clock genes, melatonin and metabolism.

productions.title: Bioelectric pattern control
productions.claim: Explain how membrane voltage patterns store and control anatomical form during development and regeneration.

productions.title: Programmed versus stochastic aging
productions.claim: Decide whether aging is a program, accumulated damage or an entropy process, and which clock measures it.

productions.title: Hard problem of consciousness
productions.claim: Explain why physical processes give rise to subjective experience.

productions.title: Neural binding problem
productions.claim: Explain how the brain combines features processed in separate areas into one percept.

productions.title: Free energy principle formalization
productions.claim: Friston's claim that self-organizing systems minimize variational free energy. Formal status and falsifiability are debated.

productions.title: AI alignment verification
productions.claim: Verify that a learned system pursues the objectives its designers intend, with guarantees.

productions.title: Formal reasoning limits of transformers
productions.claim: Bound what fixed-depth transformers compute, with and without chain of thought, in circuit complexity terms.

productions.title: Autoformalization of mathematics
productions.claim: Translate informal mathematics into Lean or other formal languages automatically and at scale.

productions.title: Smale's 18th problem limits of intelligence
productions.claim: Smale's 18th problem asks for the limits of intelligence, human and artificial.

productions.title: Market efficiency as computational hardness
productions.claim: Maymin argued weak-form market efficiency holds if and only if P = NP. The link between hardness and arbitrage stays open.

productions.title: Complexity of computing Nash equilibria
productions.claim: Computing a Nash equilibrium is PPAD-complete. Daskalakis, Goldberg and Papadimitriou proved it in 2006.

productions.title: Optimal multi-item auction design
productions.claim: Myerson solved single-item revenue-optimal auctions in 1981. The multi-item case has no closed form.

productions.title: Rough volatility pricing
productions.claim: Volatility is rough, with Hurst exponent near 0.1. Pricing and hedging under rough volatility lacks closed forms.

productions.title: Elliptic curve discrete log hardness
productions.claim: Asks whether the elliptic curve discrete log problem has a subexponential classical algorithm. Bitcoin and TLS rely on it.

productions.title: Succinct proofs without trusted setup optimality
productions.claim: Asks for the optimal proof size and verifier time for transparent succinct arguments.

productions.title: Climate sensitivity bound
productions.claim: Narrow equilibrium climate sensitivity, now 2.5 to 4 degrees per CO2 doubling, mostly through cloud feedback.

productions.title: Plasma confinement stability
productions.claim: Predict and suppress plasma instabilities in magnetic confinement well enough for net energy gain.

plots.title: Token circle
plots.caption: Every keyword and market token sits on the circle in the order of its embedding similarity. Distance from the centre is the mean solvability of the problems that use it.

plots.title: Star chart
plots.caption: Angle is semantic position. Radius grows with level and with distance from a solution. Star size counts the markets a problem touches.

plots.title: Star chart through time
plots.caption: Radius is the year a problem was posed. A line runs out to a black dot at the year it was resolved.

plots.title: Solvability helix
plots.caption: One turn per level. Angle is semantic rank, radius is solvability.

plots.title: Sphere map
plots.caption: The top three principal directions of the embeddings, projected onto the unit sphere. Opacity is solvability.

plots.title: Similarity network
plots.caption: Each node links to its six most similar nodes. Node size is betweenness centrality.

plots.title: Problem similarity matrix
plots.caption: Cosine similarity between problems, ordered by network community.

plots.title: Branch, status and market matrices
plots.caption: Branch against branch mean similarity, level against formal status, and market against branch.

plots.title: Token similarity matrix
plots.caption: Cosine similarity between tokens, ordered by their position on the circle.
